messages:
Maya (PM): quick hit — dropped a compact mock of pool preview that tries to show burst heuristics + min/max at a glance. thinking about a small nudge when users pick a pool with low burst headroom :eyes: Liam (Designer): love the nudge idea. can we surface the expected latency delta (p50/p95) next to the burst number? tiny number, maybe hover detail Anne (Frontend): hover is fine but we need a11y fallback. keyboard users should be able to expand details with Enter. also color contrast on the burst pill is borderline on dark bg Samir (SRE): if we show expected latency, it should be relative to current model routing. different models have different baselines. we could show "~ +30ms" instead of absolute ms to avoid confusion Liam (Designer): good call. show relative delta and a tooltip: "Estimate based on recent serving profile for selected model" Maya (PM): copy idea: "Burst headroom — estimated latency impact" or shorter: "Burst impact". which reads clearer in the compact card? Anne (Frontend): "Burst impact" shorter but ambiguous. maybe "Burst impact (est.)" works. for screen readers add aria-label that expands: "Burst impact, estimated latency increase and extra cost" Samir (SRE): ops-bot FYI can we wire a flag so Dedicated customers see exact numbers but hosted sees estimates? @ops-bot can add a note to the rollout plan ops-bot: noted. created ticket INF-5143 with assignee @Samir and tag "burst-preview" — https://jira.redwood/INF-5143 :white_check_mark: Liam (Designer): UX nit: min/max stepper + burst pill are visually competing. what if we collapse the stepper into an inline compact control when pool is pinned? keeps card height low Maya (PM): thinking about guardrails — if user chooses a pool with zero burst, show inline warning: "No burst available — requests may queue under spikes" with a CTA "Switch pool" Anne (Frontend): accessibility for that warning: needs role=alert so screen readers announce it immediately. sample snippet: ```
No burst available — requests may queue
``` Also ensure the CTA is focusable and in tab order Liam (Designer): microcopy tweak: replace "Switch pool" with "Choose pool with burst" — more explicit and reduces accidental clicks Maya (PM): good. last question: should the SLO slider snap to presets (low/medium/high) or be fully free? users asked for presets in research Samir (SRE): presets for quick setup + free slider for power users. default to medium preset, but allow keyboard arrows to nudge by 1 unit and show exact numeric SLO in tooltip Anne (Frontend): implementation note: animate slider changes but respect prefers-reduced-motion. also ensure aria-valuetext reads percent + preset name when snapping Liam (Designer): agree. I'll update mocks with: relative latency delta, burst pill contrast improved, collapsed stepper state, new warning copy, and presets visible when focused Maya (PM): perfect — thanks team. Samir/Anne can you estimate effort by EOD? I'll add the mock + jira link to the ticket Samir (SRE): i'll put rough estimate in INF-5143 by 5pm Anne (Frontend): same, will add frontend tasks and prototype notes Maya (PM): closing loop — :thumbsup:
